relative_slo_proxy: ITL <= 1.5 times paired decode-only median ITL
best_lp_rule: Lowest paired response-window peak VSEL among valid G4/G8/G16; evaluate G24/G48 if G16 still violates proxy. Report TTFT trade-off separately.
ep_common_promotion: Material >=15-20% reproducible penalty in both tuned CP and LP, explained by the same EP component, not integration overhead.
modality_common_promotion: Approximately matched tokens; visual penalty >=15% in both CP and LP; paired CI excludes negligible effect; same physical cause.
